localizedValues.name: Bert's Cabin
localizedValues.description: Access to the site is by boat, canoe or kayak. There is no running water and no water pump. Firewood can be purchased through the Park Operator. There are two bunk beds in the cabin (fitting two people comfortably, up to 4 persons max) and three tent pads outside. Tents are only allowed to be placed on tent pads. Access is from the boat launch and vehicles can be parked in the day-use parking lot. From the boat launch, Bert’s Cabin is approximately 800 m in a straight line. It is located on the most prominent point on the left. Cabin must be left in the same condition that it was found. Please pack out what you pack in. Please ensure all windows and doors are shut and the fire is completely out. Garbage can be placed in the receptacles located in the main campground.
This is a first-come, first-served campsite. Site availability can only be confirmed in-person, at the park.
